definitions.explanation: A traditional festival on May 5th celebrating the health and growth of boys. Families display warrior dolls, fly carp streamers, and eat special foods like kashiwamochi and chimaki.

examples.english: The Boys' Day festival is on May 5th and is an event to pray for the healthy growth of boys.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
One of the {五節句|ごせっく} (five seasonal festivals). May 5th is also a national holiday called こども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Children's Day). Traditional decorations include ⟦{五月人形|ごがつにんぎょう}→五月人形：27110_gogatsuningyou⟧ (warrior dolls), ⟦{鯉|こい}のぼり→鯉のぼり：05711_koinobori⟧ (carp streamers symbolizing strength and perseverance), and ⟦{兜|かぶと}→兜：11625_kabuto⟧ (samurai helmets). Special foods include ⟦{柏餅|かしわもち}→柏餅：19485_kashiwamochi⟧ and {粽|ちまき}. Families also take {菖蒲湯|しょうぶゆ} (iris baths) to ward off evil.
